mapper.select:
select r.id, r.task_id, t.task_no, r.equipment_id, e.code as equipment_code, e.name as equipment_name, r.inspector_id, u.display_name as inspector_name, r.normal, r.completed_at from inspection_record r join inspection_task t on t.id = r.task_id join equipment e on e.id = r.equipment_id join sys_user u on u.id = r.inspector_id
and t.task_no like concat('%', #{taskNo}, '%') and r.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} and r.inspector_id = #{inspectorId} and r.normal = #{normal} and r.completed_at >= #{completedFrom} and r.completed_at < date_add(#{completedTo}, interval 1 day)
order by r.completed_at desc, r.id desc

select r.id, r.task_id, t.task_no, r.equipment_id, e.code as equipment_code, e.name as equipment_name, a.name as area_name, r.inspector_id, u.display_name as inspector_name, r.normal, r.remark, r.completed_at, (select f.id from fault_record f where f.inspection_record_id = r.id limit 1) as fault_record_id from inspection_record r join inspection_task t on t.id = r.task_id join equipment e on e.id = r.equipment_id join area a on a.id = e.area_id join sys_user u on u.id = r.inspector_id where r.id = #{inspectionRecordId}

select inspection_item_id, item_code_snapshot as item_code, item_name_snapshot as item_name, result_type_snapshot as result_type, standard_description_snapshot as standard_description, result_value, unit_snapshot as unit, normal, remark from inspection_record_item where inspection_record_id = #{inspectionRecordId} order by id
select f.url from biz_attachment b join file_object f on f.id = b.file_id where b.biz_type = 'INSPECTION' and b.biz_id = #{inspectionRecordId} order by b.sort_no, b.id
mapper.insert: insert into inspection_record (task_id, task_equipment_id, equipment_id, inspector_id, normal, remark, completed_at) values (#{taskId}, #{taskEquipmentId}, #{equipmentId}, #{inspectorId}, #{normal}, #{remark}, #{completedAt})

insert into inspection_record_item (inspection_record_id, inspection_item_id, item_code_snapshot, item_name_snapshot, standard_description_snapshot, result_type_snapshot, result_value, unit_snapshot, normal, remark) values (#{inspectionRecordId}, #{inspectionItemId}, #{itemCodeSnapshot}, #{itemNameSnapshot}, #{standardDescriptionSnapshot}, #{resultTypeSnapshot}, #{resultValue}, #{unitSnapshot}, #{normal}, #{remark})
